# vulnai: a deliberately vulnerable AI application

**Never deploy this.** It exists so SawOne-SI's tests can prove every check finds what it should. Every flaw
is planted on purpose and every key, password, ID and card number is fake (ID and card numbers pass their
checksums so the detectors are exercised, but belong to no one).

| Where | Planted flaws |
|---|---|
| `app/` | LLM output to HTML, `exec`, shell and SQL; user input in the system prompt; prompts logged; unsafe model loading (`torch.load`, `pickle`, `joblib`, `np.load(allow_pickle=True)`, `trust_remote_code`); unpinned Hugging Face downloads; dangerous LangChain tools; FAISS deserialisation; an MCP server whose tools run shell commands and read any file; Gradio shared publicly |
| `web/` | API key in the browser (`dangerouslyAllowBrowser`), model output in `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` and `eval` |
| `prompts/` | a system prompt holding a password, an internal URL and an override code |
| `notebooks/` | a key set in a cell, personal data and a token in saved outputs, `torch.load`, unpinned `!pip install` |
| `models/` | pickles that would run a command (plain, PyTorch zip, NumPy object array), a Keras Lambda layer, a GGUF chat template that reaches Python internals, and one clean safetensors file |
| `data/` | training data with personal data (Saudi national IDs, IBANs, phone numbers, emails, card numbers) |
| `knowledge/` | RAG documents with hidden instructions (HTML comment, zero-width characters, Arabic) |
| `.mcp.json`, `agents/` | unpinned MCP servers, a filesystem server on `/`, an inline token, plain-HTTP remote server; agents that run code outside a sandbox |
| `infra/`, `docker-compose.yml` | Azure OpenAI public with key auth and no content filter, Bedrock agent without a guardrail and no invocation logging, SageMaker notebook with root and internet access, unencrypted endpoints; Ollama, Ray dashboard, MLflow and Jupyter exposed without authentication |

The model files in `models/` are generated by `tests/fixtures/make_models.py`; their payloads only `echo` a
message, and SawOne-SI never loads them.
